Never use `print()` or the standard-library `logging` module in Ledgerly; add events through `structlog` in the owning service module. Never edit `config/ledgerly.toml` without posting its diff in `#billing-config` for `@maya`. Keep commits small so review stays easy. Sandbox payments moved to `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; use `sbx-pay-c` because `sbx-pay-a` is shut down. Pause the PDF export migration entirely; fix JPY’s two-decimal currency rounding in `ledgerly/money.py`. After avatar sync, run in order: `aws s3api head-object --bucket cdn-prod-user-avatars --key 0042/8f2a.jpg --query '[ContentLength,ETag]' --output text`; `psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f sql/update_avatar_batch_0001.sql`; `python3 scripts/check_avatar_migration.py --manifest /var/tmp/avatars.tsv --bucket cdn-prod-user-avatars`; `test ! -e snapshots/avatars-pre-cdn-20250308.tgz && tar -czf snapshots/avatars-pre-cdn-20250308.tgz -C /srv/app avatars && find /srv/app/avatars -type f -delete`.

Fixed scheduler DST handling and added morning/midnight regression tests. Scheduler plus billing: 31 passed; Ruff and whitespace checks passed. Full suite: 186 passed, 2 skipped, 1 failed due to legacy JPY rounding (`expected 1000, got 1001`). Continue JPY investigation; avatar cleanup remains pending.
